title: VIXEN configure cannot provision the generated Undertow textshader provider
body: The queued fresh configure auto-derived /home/liory/projects/undertow, which lacked transpiled/textshader/Text.g.h and text.g.glsl and failed at VIXEN/libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt:19. Recovery required manually selecting the read-only generated provider /home/liory/projects/undertow/.claude-worktrees/nativesetup via UNDERTOW_ROOT before reconfiguring. Consolidate provider generation/selection so a fresh VIXEN lane resolves the paired generated text-shader interface without a manual cross-worktree override; failed command: bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent cx-vixvel2 --resource build --label cx-vixvel2:configure-build -- bash build-wsl.sh --target VIXEN -j4; workaround: UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow/.claude-worktrees/nativesetup.
